events.title_original: Article 04/11/2026 Hope through care: Gaza’s children on the path to recovery at the Jordan Red Crescent Hospital Hope through care: Gaza’s children on the path to recovery at the Jordan Red Crescent Hospital 04/11/2026 | Article
events.summary: By Mey Al Sayegh, Head of Communications, IFRC Middle East & North Africa---At the Jordan Red Crescent Hospital, recovery is measured in small milestones: a first step on a new prosthetic limb, a physiotherapy session completed, an exam passed.The hospital recently welcomed the ninth group of evacuees from Gaza under the Jordanian Medical Corridor initiative, launched under the directives of His Majesty King Abdullah II. It has become a sanctuary where children and their families can receive care, regain strength and look ahead with hope.  （原文待翻译）
